definitions.explanation: Something one hopes for or wants to happen.
A formal or polite request for something.

examples.japanese: {願|ねが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}った→叶う：05303_kanau⟧。
examples.notes: {願|ねが}いが{叶|かな}う = wish comes true

examples.japanese: {願|ねが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}います→叶う：05303_kanau⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧。
⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{願|ねが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めた→込める：01945_komeru⟧。
examples.english: I made a wish upon a star.
examples.notes: {願|ねが}いを{込|こ}める = to put one's wish into

examples.english: Hoping for a child's happiness is every parent's greatest wish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{願|ねが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: This festival is held every year with a wish for peace.

examples.japanese: お{願|ねが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a request (favor to ask).

examples.japanese: お{願|ねが}い⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: One of the most common polite expressions in Japanese

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧{願|ねが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{推薦状|すいせんじょう}→推薦状：15195_suisenjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{願|ねが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I asked my teacher for a letter of recommendation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧{願|ねが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧、⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a leave request and submitted it to my boss.
examples.notes: {休暇|きゅうか}{願|ねが}い = leave request

notes:
USAGE: {願|ねが}い is the noun form of ⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧ (to wish). It's used for hopes, wishes, and formal requests.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {願|ねが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{叶|かな}う→叶う：05303_kanau⟧ (a wish comes true)
- {願|ねが}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧ (to put one's wish into)
- お{願|ねが}い⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧ (please - polite request)
- お{願|ねが}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a request/favor)

FORMAL REQUEST FORMS:
- ⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧{願|ねが}い (leave request)
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧{願|ねが}い (resignation request)
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦{願書|がんしょ}→願書：16223_gansho⟧ (application for admission)

NOTE: お{願|ねが}いします is one of the most important polite expressions in Japanese, used for requests and saying 'please'.
